request.description: Analysis progress in the app's shape: `running`, `done` or `failed` with `done` / `active` / `pending` steps. Compat layer for the current app (plan §10.3): the app sets `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=<host>/v0`. The case is the borrower's newest open application, resolved server side because the app never sends one. Removed once the app moves to `/v1`.
